reflection.title: Your agents build the tools they need

beats.caption: Every session, your agent starts from zero.
It repeats the same work, figuring out how to do it from scratch every time.
So nock records, on your machine, what every session did…
…and every once in a while, you send your agent to reflect on this history and write the tools it was missing.
The next sessions use it, so five calls become one…
…and future reflection rounds keep calibrating the toolbox: adding what's missing, retiring what's unused, sharpening what's there.
Agents that get better at your project, every week.

review.title: You decide, when it suits you

beats.caption: Suppose your agent makes some calls while you're away.
Each one lands in Work, under the topic it belongs to, for you to review.
Not just decisions: anything you might want eyes on. Microcopy, rendered screens, interaction videos.
Choose between options, and compare versions side by side.
Leave comments or questions. Your agent addresses them in bulk, with new versions and its own thoughts.
Then accept or reject the work, and it becomes part of your project's history…
…so future agents can consult it at any time, and stay aligned with your product vision.
Agents never wait on you. You review when it suits you.
